prompt.alinti: Don't post anything else on Instagram until you install these five Claude skills.
We put 52 free skills on GitHub that turn Claude into your content team.
The first one makes your reels. The hook, every scene, the voiceover, and the music rendered into a finished video.
The second builds your carousels. 10 slides, from the cover to the last one people save.
The third writes your caption, with a first line built for the part people see before more.
The fourth audits your profile and rewrites your bio so visitors actually follow.
And the last one handles your comments. It replies to every single one and DMs them what they asked for.
Connect it to auto and it designs your slides, renders your reels, and posts them straight to your Instagram.
Comment Instagram and follow me and I'll send you the full install step by step.

yontem.ne: Instagram içeriği otomatik üretimi için AI araçları.

akis.ne: Kullanıcıya 5 Claude Skills'ini tanıtır ve Instagram içeriği oluşturma sürecini anlatır.
